'''Sportklub Niederösterreich St. Pölten''' is an Austrian [[association football|football]] club from [[St Pölten|Sankt Pölten]], capital of the Austrian state of [[Lower Austria]]. St. Pölten currently play in the [[2. Liga (Austria)|Austrian Football Second League]], the second tier of the Austrian football league system.<ref>[https://int.soccerway.com/teams/austria/skn-sankt-polten/ SKN St Pölten – News, Squad, Results & Fixtures – Soccerway]</ref>"}}
